svg.title: Agent configuration layering
svg.desc: Three layers compose into every agent run: an always-on base layer (root AGENTS.md, alwaysApply security rules, deterministic hooks), a stack layer of nested AGENTS.md files scoped by directory (Angular frontend, .NET backend, Python tools), and a role layer of subagent definitions with per-stack implementer and test-writer variants plus one shared verifier.
svg.text: Base layer — always on, every agent, every surface

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What belongs in the root AGENTS.md base layer?')
sendPrompt('What security rules should be alwaysApply in .cursor/rules?')
sendPrompt('Which guardrails must be hooks rather than rules, and why?')

svg.text: Stack layer — nested AGENTS.md + glob-scoped rules

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What goes in the frontend React AGENTS.md?')
sendPrompt('What goes in the backend .NET AGENTS.md?')
sendPrompt('What goes in the Python tools AGENTS.md?')
sendPrompt('How does the orchestrator route to the right per-stack implementer?')
sendPrompt('Why does the test-writer need a per-stack variant?')
sendPrompt('Why can the verifier subagent stay shared across stacks?')
